title: Generational War on Inflation? Optimal Inflation Rates for the Young and the Old
title_zh: 代际通胀之争？年轻人与老年人的最优通胀率
title_primary: 代际通胀之争？年轻人与老年人的最优通胀率
title_secondary: Generational War on Inflation? Optimal Inflation Rates for the Young and the Old
authors: Ippei Fujiwara, Shunsuke Hori, Yuichiro Waki
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How does population aging affect the political decision-making regarding the inflation target? Using an overlapping generations New Keynesian model, we analyze how demographic factors affect the inflation target rates preferred by young and old households, respectively. Given a demographic structure, the earnings redistribution channel leads young and old households to have different preferences over the inflation target: the optimal target rate for the average old household is negative, whereas that for the average young household is close to zero. Hence, the composition effect of population aging on the population-weighted average of these optimal rates is negative. However, the overall effect is either positive or only marginally negative, depending on whether the transition to a new steady state is taken into account, and there is no strong negative association between the population-weighted average of the optimal inflation rates and population aging. The analysis reveals that greater longevity and lower birth rates make the preferences of young and old households more similar, either directly through utility functions or indirectly through a lower real interest rate.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化如何影响关于通胀目标的政治决策？通过运用世代交叠的新凯恩斯模型，我们分析了人口因素如何分别影响年轻与老年家庭所偏好的通胀目标率。在给定的人口结构下，收入再分配渠道导致年轻与老年家庭对通胀目标持有不同偏好：平均老年家庭的最优目标率为负，而平均年轻家庭的最优目标率接近于零。因此，人口老龄化对人口加权平均最优目标率的构成效应为负。然而，总体效应要么为正，要么仅为轻微负值，这取决于是否考虑向新稳态的过渡，且人口加权平均最优通胀率与人口老龄化之间并无强烈的负相关关系。分析揭示，寿命延长和出生率降低使得年轻与老年家庭的偏好趋于一致，这种趋同或直接通过效用函数实现，或间接通过较低的实际利率实现。

title: Incremental information value of alternative data and return forecasting in an emerging crude oil futures market: evidence from China
title_zh: 新兴原油期货市场中另类数据的增量信息价值与收益预测：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 新兴原油期货市场中另类数据的增量信息价值与收益预测：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Incremental information value of alternative data and return forecasting in an emerging crude oil futures market: evidence from China
authors: Longyue Liang, Ruiyang Luo, Ruiguang Luo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study explores whether alternative data provide incremental predictive information for crude oil return forecasting in emerging markets, focusing on China’s Shanghai International Energy Exchange (INE) crude oil futures market. We construct a comprehensive forecasting framework that integrates traditional econometric benchmarks, mixed-frequency specifications, and deep learning models, and evaluate predictive performance through return forecasting, interval prediction for uncertainty quantification, a mean-variance framework for economic value assessment, and interpretable machine learning for information contribution analysis. The results show that deep learning models generally achieve better out-of-sample forecast accuracy and directional predictability than conventional linear benchmarks. Incorporating alternative data provides incremental predictive information beyond traditional predictors and improves the economic performance of forecasting-based portfolios. Furthermore, feature ablation and interpretability analyses reveal that different categories of alternative data provide heterogeneous incremental predictive signals, with their relative importance varying across market conditions. These findings enhance the understanding of how alternative information contributes to return predictability and information processing in the INE market, and offer practical implications for forecasting, risk assessment, and information infrastructure development in this market. KEYWORDS: Alternative data crude oil futures return forecasting emerging markets machine learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: C45 C53 G17 Q41
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了替代数据是否为新兴市场原油期货收益预测提供了增量预测信息，重点关注中国上海国际能源交易中心（INE）原油期货市场。我们构建了一个综合预测框架，整合了传统计量经济学基准模型、混频规格和深度学习模型，并通过收益预测、用于不确定性量化的区间预测、用于经济价值评估的均值-方差框架以及用于信息贡献分析的可解释机器学习来评估预测性能。结果表明，深度学习模型通常比传统线性基准模型实现更好的样本外预测准确性和方向可预测性。纳入替代数据提供了超越传统预测因子的增量预测信息，并改善了基于预测的投资组合的经济表现。此外，特征消融和可解释性分析揭示，不同类别的替代数据提供了异质性的增量预测信号，其相对重要性随市场条件而变化。这些发现增进了对替代信息如何促进INE市场收益可预测性和信息处理的理解，并为该市场的预测、风险评估和信息基础设施建设提供了实践启示。关键词：替代数据 原油期货 收益预测 新兴市场 机器学习 JEL分类号：C45 C53 G17 Q41

title: Trust, Rule of Law, and the Size Premium: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 信任、法治与规模溢价：来自元分析的证据
title_primary: 信任、法治与规模溢价：来自元分析的证据
title_secondary: Trust, Rule of Law, and the Size Premium: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis
authors: Jiri Schwarz, Tomas Havranek, Zuzana Irsova, Jiri Novak
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Reported estimates of the size premium, the tendency of smaller firms to earn higher average returns than larger firms, vary widely across studies, countries, periods, and designs. We examine whether generalized trust and rule of law help account for that heterogeneity. Small firms are more opaque and more dependent on outside finance, so the enforcement and information environment should matter more for them than for large firms. We study 1,613 reported size-slope estimates from 105 studies and 31 countries. The meta-regressions control for study design, specification, precision, publication context, and market and macro-financial conditions; Bayesian model averaging assesses uncertainty over the control set. The more stable association is with rule of law, and it runs against the intuitive expectation that better legal institutions shrink the premium: stronger rule of law is associated with more negative reported size slopes, hence larger conventional size premia. The trust association is conditional and less precisely estimated: where rule of law is weak, higher generalized trust is linked to less negative reported slopes (and thus a weaker premium), and this link fades as rule of law strengthens. Formal and informal institutions thus help organize part of the disagreement in this literature, although the analysis concerns variation in reported estimates and does not identify causal effects.
abstract_zh: 关于规模溢价（即小公司平均回报率高于大公司的趋势）的估计结果，在不同研究、国家、时期及设计间差异显著。我们探讨了普遍信任与法治是否有助于解释这一异质性。小公司更为不透明，且更依赖外部融资，因此执法与信息环境对其影响应大于大公司。我们分析了来自105项研究、31个国家的1,613个规模斜率估计值。元回归分析控制了研究设计、规格、精确度、发表背景及市场与宏观金融条件；贝叶斯模型平均法评估了控制集的不确定性。与法治的关联更为稳定，且与直觉预期相反——更好的法律机构并未缩小溢价：更强的法治与更负的规模斜率报告值相关，从而对应更大的传统规模溢价。信任的关联则具有条件性且估计精度较低：在法治薄弱的环境中，较高的普遍信任与较不显著的负斜率报告值（即较弱的溢价）相关，而这一关联随法治加强而减弱。因此，正式与非正式制度有助于部分梳理该文献中的分歧，尽管分析涉及报告估计值的变异性，并未识别因果效应。

title: Tariff Incidence and Market Power: Evidence from the 2025 US Tariff Shock
title_zh: 关税归宿与市场势力：来自2025年美国关税冲击的证据
title_primary: 关税归宿与市场势力：来自2025年美国关税冲击的证据
title_secondary: Tariff Incidence and Market Power: Evidence from the 2025 US Tariff Shock
authors: Caroline Freund
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using monthly bilateral trade data for 50 countries at the HTS-10 product level, this paper finds that foreign exporters absorbed 40-50 percent of the tariff increases, consistent with optimal tariff theory. Absorption was highly unequal: dominant exporters absorbed 50–65 percent of the tariff shock through lower export prices, while smaller suppliers passed through most or all of the tariff. The results differ from previous studies finding near-complete pass-through for the 2025 tariff shock because of asymmetrical treatment of suppliers. Other studies evaluate whether the typical trade partner absorbed tariffs—it did not. But given trade is highly skewed, with the top exporting country in a product accounting for nearly 50 percent of trade on average, and the top 1 percent of products accounting for over 50 percent of trade, the focus here is on aggregate effects. Provided the largest suppliers are absorbing tariffs, consumer prices will rise by less. The results are robust to a wide range of controls.
abstract_zh: 本文利用50个国家在HTS-10产品层面的月度双边贸易数据，发现外国出口商吸收了40%-50%的关税增长，这与最优关税理论一致。吸收程度高度不均：主导出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了50%-65%的关税冲击，而较小供应商则转嫁了大部分或全部关税。这一结果与先前研究发现2025年关税冲击近乎完全转嫁的结论不同，原因在于对供应商的非对称处理。其他研究评估了典型贸易伙伴是否吸收关税——结论是否定的。但由于贸易高度倾斜，产品层面最大出口国平均占贸易额近50%，且前1%的产品占贸易额超过50%，本文聚焦于总体效应。只要最大供应商吸收关税，消费者价格涨幅就会更小。该结果在广泛的控制变量下依然稳健。

title: The AI premium
title_zh: 人工智能溢价
title_primary: 人工智能溢价
title_secondary: The AI premium
authors: Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Artificial intelligence is already reshaping the economy and society. This column analyses how AI affects firms, markets, and workers using 380 trillion tokens of realised AI consumption. It calculates the sensitivity of stocks to growth in AI use and estimates a premium capturing how the equity market values that sensitivity. Firms with higher sensitivity earn higher subsequent returns. The AI premium is highest for developed markets, frontier models, experienced users, and complex tasks. Equity markets furthermore associate the AI transition more positively with work involving implementation, communication, and coordination than with analytical and scientific tasks.
abstract_zh: 人工智能正在重塑经济与社会。本文基于380万亿个已实现的人工智能消费标记，分析了人工智能如何影响企业、市场与劳动者。研究计算了股票对人工智能使用增长的敏感度，并估算了股票市场对该敏感度定价的溢价。敏感度较高的企业后续获得了更高的回报。人工智能溢价在发达市场、前沿模型、经验丰富的用户以及复杂任务中最为显著。此外，相较于分析与科学类任务，股票市场将人工智能转型与涉及实施、沟通和协调的工作更积极地关联起来。

title: On Public Opinion Polls and Voters' Turnout
title_zh: 关于民意调查与选民投票率的研究
title_primary: 关于民意调查与选民投票率的研究
title_secondary: On Public Opinion Polls and Voters' Turnout
authors: Esteban Klor, Eyal Winter, Holly Dykstra, Christine Exley, Muriel Niederle 等
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the effects that the revelation of information on the electorate's preferences has on voters' turnout decisions. The experimental data show that closeness in the division of preferences induces a significant increase in turnout. Moreover, for closely divided electorates (and only for these electorates) the provision of information significantly raises the participation of subjects supporting the slightly larger team relative to the smaller team. This behaviour contradicts the qualitative predictions of the unique quasi-symmetric Nash equilibrium of the theoretical model. We show that the heterogeneous effect of information on the participation of subjects in different teams is driven by the subjects' (incorrect) beliefs of casting a pivotal vote. Simply put, subjects overestimate the probability of casting a pivotal vote when they belong to the team with a slight majority, and choose the strategy that maximizes their utility based on their inflated probability assessment. Empirical evidence on gubernatorial elections in the U.S. between 1990 and 2005 is consistent with our main experimental result. Namely, we observe that the difference in the actual vote tally between the party leading according to the polls and the other party is larger than the one predicted by the polls only in closely divided electorates. We provide a behavioural model that explains the main findings of our experimental and empirical analyses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了选民偏好信息揭示对投票参与决策的影响。实验数据表明，偏好分歧的接近程度会显著提高投票率。此外，在偏好分歧较小的选民群体中（且仅针对此类群体），信息提供会显著提升支持略占优势阵营的参与者相对于支持较小阵营者的参与度。这一行为与理论模型中唯一拟对称纳什均衡的定性预测相悖。我们证明，信息对不同阵营参与者参与度的异质性影响源于参与者对自身投票成为关键票概率的（错误）信念。简言之，当参与者属于略占多数阵营时，会高估其投票成为关键票的概率，并基于这种膨胀的概率评估选择效用最大化的策略。1990年至2005年间美国州长选举的实证证据与我们的主要实验结果一致：仅在偏好分歧较小的选民群体中，实际投票结果中民调领先政党与其他政党之间的得票差异大于民调预测值。我们构建了一个行为模型来解释实验与实证分析的主要发现。

title: The Effects of Social Movements: Evidence from #MeToo
title_zh: 社会运动的影响：来自#MeToo运动的证据
title_primary: 社会运动的影响：来自#MeToo运动的证据
title_secondary: The Effects of Social Movements: Evidence from #MeToo
authors: Ro’ee Levy, Martin Mattsson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of the MeToo movement on reports of sex crimes to the police. Using multiple empirical strategies, including a triple-difference design comparing crime types across countries and over time, we find that the movement increased reported sex crimes by approximately 10%. Analyzing incident-level US data, we find that the movement also increased arrests and had similar effects across racial and socioeconomic groups. The evidence suggests that the increase reflects a higher propensity to report sex crimes rather than an increase in their incidence. Our results demonstrate that social movements can rapidly and persistently change high-stakes personal decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了MeToo运动对向警方报告性犯罪的影响。通过多种实证策略（包括比较不同国家、不同时期犯罪类型的三重差分设计），我们发现该运动使报告的性犯罪数量增加了约10%。对美国事件层面数据的分析表明，该运动还提高了逮捕率，且对不同种族和社会经济群体产生了相似的影响。证据显示，这一增长反映的是性犯罪报告倾向的提高，而非性犯罪发生率的上升。我们的结果表明，社会运动能够迅速且持续地改变高风险的个体决策。

title: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
title_zh: 关于多次承担偏斜风险
title_primary: 关于多次承担偏斜风险
title_secondary: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
authors: Sebastian Ebert Ebert, Mats Köster
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Penny-picking refers to the often-observed phenomenon of repeatedly taking negatively skewed risks and seems directly at odds with evidence on (positive-)skewness-seeking as observed in static settings. We show that penny-picking may not only occur despite skewness-seeking, but—seemingly paradoxically—because of skewness-seeking. With sufficient time available, risks with arbitrary negative skewness can be gambled in such a way that, overall, skewness is positive. Therefore, classical behavioral theories like prospect theory straightforwardly explain penny-picking. More generally, we show that the versatile dynamics of skewness reconcile apparent preference reversals concerning the avoidance and acceptance of (skewed and non-skewed) risks. (JEL D81, D91, G11, G41)
abstract_zh: 捡硬币”现象指反复承担负偏态风险的常见行为，这与静态环境下观察到的（正）偏态偏好证据直接矛盾。我们证明，捡硬币行为不仅可能发生在偏态偏好存在的情况下，而且——看似矛盾地——恰恰源于偏态偏好。当时间足够充裕时，任意负偏态风险可通过特定博弈方式转化为整体正偏态。因此，前景理论等经典行为理论能直接解释捡硬币现象。更一般地，我们揭示了偏态的动态特性如何调和了关于规避与接受（偏态与非偏态）风险的表面偏好反转现象。（JEL D81, D91, G11, G41）

title: Class Disparities and Discrimination in Traffic Stops and Searches
title_zh: 交通拦截与搜查中的阶级差异与歧视
title_primary: 交通拦截与搜查中的阶级差异与歧视
title_secondary: Class Disparities and Discrimination in Traffic Stops and Searches
authors: Feigenberg, Benjamin, Miller, Conrad
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study class disparities in highway patrol traffic stops. Low-income motorists are more likely to be searched for contraband, less likely to be found with contraband when searched, and more likely to be stopped for infractions associated with pretext stops. To measure class-based discrimination, we leverage motorists stopped in multiple vehicles conveying different class signals. Motorists are more likely to be searched when stopped in a low-status vehicle, and evidence suggests that they are also more likely to be stopped when driving one. Marginal searches triggered by vehicle status are less likely to yield contraband when the motorist is low-income.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了高速公路巡警交通拦截中的阶层差异。低收入驾驶者更可能因违禁品被搜查，搜查时被发现携带违禁品的概率更低，且更可能因与借口性拦截相关的违规行为被拦停。为衡量基于阶层的歧视，我们利用了驾驶不同阶层信号车辆的驾驶者被拦截的数据。驾驶低地位车辆时，驾驶者更可能被搜查，且有证据表明他们驾驶此类车辆时也更可能被拦停。由车辆地位引发的边际搜查中，若驾驶者为低收入群体，查获违禁品的可能性更低。

title: The EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility: Experience and lessons for the next multiannual financial framework
title_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金：对下一个多年期财政框架的经验与启示
title_primary: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金：对下一个多年期财政框架的经验与启示
title_secondary: The EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility: Experience and lessons for the next multiannual financial framework
authors: Matthias Busse, Francesca Caselli, Alexandra Fotiou
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility has become a central test case for performance-based fiscal policy. Its experience offers lessons for the design of the next Multiannual Financial Framework. This column reviews evidence on the facility’s economic impact, implementation, and use of milestones and targets. It argues that the facility has supported demand, helped advance reforms, and strengthened EU fiscal integration, but that complex plans and administrative bottlenecks have slowed disbursement. Future EU budget instruments should link reforms and investment while keeping plans focused, flexible, and aligned with implementation capacity.
abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金已成为绩效导向型财政政策的核心试验案例，其经验为下一期多年期财政框架的设计提供了借鉴。本专栏梳理了该基金在经济影响、实施过程及里程碑与目标运用方面的实证证据，指出该基金在支撑需求、推动改革及强化欧盟财政一体化方面发挥了积极作用，但复杂的计划与行政瓶颈导致资金拨付进度放缓。未来欧盟预算工具应在保持计划聚焦性、灵活性与实施能力匹配度的前提下，实现改革与投资的联动。

title: Testing for Nontrivial Cointegration
title_primary: Testing for Nontrivial Cointegration
authors: Javier Hualde, José Olmo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Cointegration is pivotal in analyzing long-run equilibrium relationships among economic variables. Traditional cointegration models have been effective in handling mixed-order integrated variables, but they can lead to misleading conclusions from an equilibrium perspective if trend stationary observables are involved. This type of variable leads to the so-called trivial cointegration, which might falsely suggest a long-run relationship where none exists. Testing for nontrivial cointegration is possible using standard methods, but this necessarily requires a sequential approach, and it typically leads to an inconsistent test. This paper proposes a direct and consistent test for nontrivial cointegration in a bivariate setting motivated by the different behavior of the sample correlation between the observables under various cointegration scenarios. Our testing approach is compared with standard methods by means of a Monte Carlo experiment, and we include the analysis of an empirical application to the term structure of government nominal bond yields for the European Monetary Union area.

title: Macroprudential policy and corporate innovation: Evidence from European countries
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策与企业创新：来自欧洲国家的证据
title_primary: 宏观审慎政策与企业创新：来自欧洲国家的证据
title_secondary: Macroprudential policy and corporate innovation: Evidence from European countries
authors: Xuan Viet Ho, Luu Duc Toan Huynh, Steven Ongena
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the effect of macroprudential policy on innovation across 21 European countries from 1990 to 2021. Using 401,755 patents linked to 2,844 firms, we find that macroprudential tightening reduces both the quantity and quality of innovation. One standard deviation increase in the overall macroprudential policy index is associated with approximately a 10.1 percent decline in patent count and an 8.4 percent decline in adjusted forward citations. The effect is persistent and robust across three identification strategies: a multi-way fixed effects specification, an instrumental variable approach, and a difference-in-differences design exploiting the implementation of the European Union’s macroprudential “single rulebook” (CRR/CRD IV). The effect operates through the credit channel, is amplified for financially constrained firms, and is driven by credit-oriented, borrower-targeted, and credit cycle-smoothing instruments. Financial resilience-building instruments deliver no short term cost and possibly generate positive innovation effects at long horizons. The findings suggest that the macroprudential toolkit carries differentiated economic costs across instrument categories.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1990年至2021年间21个欧洲国家宏观审慎政策对创新的影响。基于2844家企业关联的401755项专利数据，我们发现宏观审慎政策收紧会同时降低创新的数量与质量。整体宏观审慎政策指数每增加一个标准差，专利数量约下降10.1%，经调整的前向引用次数约下降8.4%。该效应具有持续性，并在三种识别策略中保持稳健：多向固定效应模型、工具变量法，以及利用欧盟宏观审慎"单一规则手册"（CRR/CRD IV）实施构建的双重差分设计。该效应通过信贷渠道传导，在融资约束较强的企业中更为显著，且主要由信贷导向型、借款人定向型及信贷周期平滑型工具驱动。增强金融韧性的工具在短期内未产生成本，并可能在长期产生正向创新效应。研究结果表明，不同类别的宏观审慎工具具有差异化的经济成本。

title: How the U.S. child tax credit has benefited children over time: historical trends in eligibility, poverty, and income inequality
title_zh: 美国儿童税收抵免如何长期惠及儿童：资格、贫困与收入不平等的历史趋势
title_primary: 美国儿童税收抵免如何长期惠及儿童：资格、贫困与收入不平等的历史趋势
title_secondary: How the U.S. child tax credit has benefited children over time: historical trends in eligibility, poverty, and income inequality
authors: Sophie Collyer, Megan Curran, David Harris, Christopher Yera
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Unlike the universal child allowances available in many advanced democracies, the largest child-specific income benefit in the United States, the Child Tax Credit (CTC), is a function of tax liabilities and earnings. As a result, it disproportionately reaches middle- and high-income families and leaves many low-income families ineligible. This study examines, from its enactment through present day, how legislative changes to the federal Child Tax Credit’s key parameters—including refundability, the earnings requirement, and the maximum credit amount—have impacted the share of children eligible for the full credit (overall and by subgroup), and how full-credit eligibility relates to the credit’s impact on child poverty and bottom-tail income inequality, including whether these three metrics move in tandem. We find that, in all years except 2021, at least 19% of children—and often, substantially more—were ineligible for the full CTC because their families had low or moderate incomes. The sizeable variation in full-credit ineligibility across years resulted from legislative changes that widened and narrowed eligibility over time. Furthermore, the credit’s impact on child poverty and income inequality does not always move in the same direction, depending on the type of policy change. Reforms that increased the credit value without substantial expansions to refundability left more children ineligible for the full credit and increased income inequality. By contrast, refundability expansions broadened full-credit eligibility while reducing poverty and inequality. Impacts on child poverty and inequality were greatest when full refundability was paired with higher credit amounts.
abstract_zh: 与许多发达民主国家普遍提供的儿童津贴不同，美国最大的专项儿童收入补助——儿童税收抵免（CTC）——取决于纳税义务和劳动收入。因此，该政策不成比例地惠及中高收入家庭，而许多低收入家庭则不具备资格。本研究考察了自该政策实施至今，联邦儿童税收抵免关键参数（包括可退还性、收入要求及最高抵免额度）的立法调整如何影响符合全额抵免资格的儿童比例（总体及分群体），以及全额抵免资格与该政策对儿童贫困和底层收入不平等的影响之间的关系，包括这三项指标是否同步变化。我们发现，除2021年外，所有年份中至少19%的儿童（且通常比例更高）因家庭收入较低或中等而无法获得全额CTC。不同年份间全额抵免资格的巨大差异源于立法调整随时间推移扩大或缩小了资格范围。此外，该政策对儿童贫困和收入不平等的影响并非总朝同一方向变化，具体取决于政策调整的类型。提高抵免额度但未大幅扩大可退还性的改革，导致更多儿童无法获得全额抵免，并加剧了收入不平等。相比之下，扩大可退还性则拓宽了全额抵免资格，同时减少了贫困和不平等。当全额可退还性与更高抵免额度相结合时，对儿童贫困和不平等的影响最为显著。

title: Immigration, Innovation, and the Geography of Growth
title_zh: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布
title_primary: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布
title_secondary: Immigration, Innovation, and the Geography of Growth
authors: Costas Arkolakis, Sun Kyoung Lee, Michael Peters
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Between 1880 and 1920, more than 20 million immigrants settled in the United States. We study how this migration wave affected innovation and growth. Using a newly constructed dataset linking individual census records to historical immigration records and the universe of US patents, we highlight a new channel through which immigrants contributed to growth: they disproportionately settled in urban innovation hubs. To quantify the aggregate and regional effects of this mass migration episode, we develop a new spatial growth model in which skilled workers have a comparative advantage in innovation and sort endogenously across space. We find that international arrivals after 1880 raised US income per capita by 8.2% by 1940. Removing the subsequent immigration restrictions of the 1920s would have raised income per capita by a further 1.7% by 2000. Immigrants' skill composition and their concentration in urban hubs are key drivers of these effects.
abstract_zh: 1880年至1920年间，超过2000万移民在美国定居。本研究考察了此次移民浪潮对创新与经济增长的影响。通过构建将个人人口普查记录、历史移民记录及美国全部专利数据相关联的新数据集，我们揭示了移民促进经济增长的新渠道：移民不成比例地聚集于城市创新中心。为量化此次大规模移民事件的总体与区域效应，我们构建了新型空间增长模型，其中技能型劳动者在创新领域具有比较优势，并在地理空间上实现内生性分类。研究发现，1880年后的国际移民使1940年美国人均收入提升8.2%。若取消1920年代后续实施的移民限制，2000年人均收入将额外增长1.7%。移民的技能构成及其在城市创新中心的集聚效应是上述影响的关键驱动因素。

title: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
title_zh: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见
title_primary: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见
title_secondary: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
authors: Thomas Baudin, David de la Croix
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Consider the transition out of a stagnant Malthusian system spearheaded by high-human-capital people. Individuals with a stronger preference for offspring quality may be the first to escape the Malthusian regime and adopt modern fertility behaviours (Galor and Moav 2002). To test this hypothesis, we examine the relationship between family size and human capital among academics in Northern Europe in the two centuries before the Industrial Revolution. We measure the human capital of academics using a novel approach based on their publications. We find that scholars with a higher number of publications than the median shifted from having more siblings to having fewer siblings in the first half of the 18th century. Estimating the parameters of an evolutionary growth model by indirect inference, we show how Malthusian constraints initially led the high human capital families to reproduce more, before being endogenously replaced by Beckerian constraints with a tradeoff between child quality and quantity. Our results support an extension of Galor and Moav’s (2002) approach, in which the decline of Malthusian constraints is linked to the accumulation of human capital during the 18th century.
abstract_zh: 摘要 考虑一个由高人力资本个体引领的、摆脱停滞马尔萨斯体系的转型过程。对后代质量有更强偏好的个体可能率先脱离马尔萨斯体制，并采纳现代生育行为（Galor and Moav 2002）。为检验这一假说，我们考察了工业革命前两个世纪北欧学者家庭规模与人力资本之间的关系。我们采用基于学者出版物的创新方法衡量其人力资本。研究发现，在18世纪上半叶，出版数量高于中位数的学者从拥有更多兄弟姐妹转变为拥有更少兄弟姐妹。通过间接推断法估计演化增长模型参数，我们展示了马尔萨斯约束最初如何导致高人力资本家庭生育更多子女，随后被内生的贝克尔约束（子女质量与数量权衡）所取代。我们的研究结果支持对Galor and Moav（2002）理论的拓展，即马尔萨斯约束的衰退与18世纪人力资本的积累密切相关。

title: Constitutions, education and gender norms change: Evidence from Colombia
title_zh: 宪法、教育与性别规范变迁：来自哥伦比亚的证据
title_primary: 宪法、教育与性别规范变迁：来自哥伦比亚的证据
title_secondary: Constitutions, education and gender norms change: Evidence from Colombia
authors: Hector Galindo-Silva, Paula Herrera-Idárraga
official: 来源期次 2026-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How do gender norms change? This paper provides evidence that exposure to mandatory high school courses on the 1991 Colombian Constitution—which incorporated principles of gender equality—significantly influenced attitudes toward gender roles. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we compare individuals who were exposed to these courses with those who were not. The results show that constitutional education increased support for gender equality, particularly among men. The effect is stronger when a younger woman is present in the household, suggesting a possible motivation to support the empowerment of younger female relatives. We also document important gender differences in how these shifts manifest within households: women exposed to the courses were more likely to reject the idea that men should be the head of the household, whereas men’s views on intra-household roles remained largely unchanged. This contrast points to persistent resistance to gender norm change within the private sphere, even as broader attitudes become more egalitarian. Taken together, the findings underscore the role of institutional and cultural change—through constitutional reform and civic education—in fostering more egalitarian gender norms, while also highlighting the complexity of such transformations.
abstract_zh: 性别规范如何变迁？本文提供的证据表明，接触1991年哥伦比亚宪法——其中纳入了性别平等原则——的强制性高中课程，显著影响了人们对性别角色的态度。采用双重差分框架，我们比较了接触过这些课程与未接触过的个体。结果显示，宪法教育增强了对性别平等的支持，尤其是在男性中。当家庭中有较年轻的女性成员时，这一效应更为显著，暗示可能存在支持年轻女性亲属赋权的动机。我们还记录了这些转变在家庭内部表现出的重要性别差异：接触过课程的女性更可能拒绝男性应作为户主的观念，而男性对家庭内部角色的看法则基本未变。这种对比揭示了即使在更广泛态度趋于平等的同时，私人领域内对性别规范变革仍存在持续抵抗。总体而言，研究结果强调了制度与文化变革——通过宪法改革和公民教育——在促进更平等性别规范中的作用，同时也凸显了此类转型的复杂性。

title: The mental health impact for adolescents ageing out of South Africa’s child support grant
title_zh: 南非儿童抚养补助金到期对青少年心理健康的影响
title_primary: 南非儿童抚养补助金到期对青少年心理健康的影响
title_secondary: The mental health impact for adolescents ageing out of South Africa’s child support grant
authors: Tsepang Khumalo, Ronelle Burger, Marisa von Fintel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: While the benefits of cash transfers are well documented, little attention has been given to the negative effects of their cessation, particularly on mental health. We examined this question using South African longitudinal survey data comprising 7899 unique adolescents tracked as they age out of the Child Support Grant , the country’s largest cash transfer. We find that loss of the Child Support Grant leads to a decline in mental health equivalent to 0.42 of a standard deviation in the CES-D score, robust across model specifications and falsification tests. Increased job search activity points to resource mobilisation as a plausible mechanism, consistent with the Conservation of Resources framework. Effects are concentrated among adolescents in urban areas and households with lower and less diversified income. The results point to a neglected aspect of social protection: how and when cash transfers are withdrawn, particularly when this coincides with critical life stages.
abstract_zh: 尽管现金转移支付的好处已有充分记录，但其终止所带来的负面影响，尤其是对心理健康的影响，却鲜少受到关注。我们利用南非纵向调查数据，追踪了7899名青少年在退出该国最大现金转移项目——儿童抚养补助金——过程中的情况，来探讨这一问题。研究发现，失去儿童抚养补助金会导致心理健康状况下降，相当于CES-D评分中0.42个标准差的变化，这一结果在多种模型设定和证伪检验中均保持稳健。求职活动的增加表明资源动员是一个可能的机制，这与资源保护理论框架相符。影响主要集中在城市地区及收入较低且来源单一的青少年家庭中。这些结果揭示了社会保护中被忽视的一个方面：现金转移支付如何及何时被撤回，尤其是当这一过程与关键生命阶段相重叠时。

title: On the ordinal Bayesian incentive compatibility of vote share and veto share rules
title_zh: 关于投票份额与否决份额规则的序数贝叶斯激励相容性
title_primary: 关于投票份额与否决份额规则的序数贝叶斯激励相容性
title_secondary: On the ordinal Bayesian incentive compatibility of vote share and veto share rules
authors: Madhuparna Karmokar, Dipjyoti Majumdar, Souvik Roy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the structure of random ordinal Bayesian incentive compatible (OBIC) rules. We restrict attention to some special class of priors that we call “uniform-like” priors. We consider a class of priors, called top uniform priors: for any two alternatives a and b, a prior is top uniform if the aggregate probability (under the prior distribution) of preferences with respectively a and b at the top are the same. Over the unrestricted domain the uniform prior is a member of this class. We consider a class of random voting rules—random vote share rules, a generalization of plurality rule. For top uniform priors and arbitrary domains, Theorem 4.1 shows that every top monotonic and symmetric random vote share rule is OBIC. Over a domain satisfying some natural “richness” condition, we demonstrate that if a symmetric and strongly top responsive random vote share rule is OBIC with respect to some prior, then that prior must necessarily be a top uniform prior. We also provide some analogous results for veto share rules that are probabilistic generalizations of anti-plurality rule.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机序数贝叶斯激励相容（OBIC）规则的结构。我们关注一类特殊的先验分布，称之为“类均匀”先验。我们考虑一类称为顶部均匀先验的先验：对于任意两个备选方案a和b，若在先验分布下，分别以a和b为顶部的偏好总概率相同，则该先验为顶部均匀先验。在无限制域上，均匀先验属于此类。我们考虑一类随机投票规则——随机投票份额规则，这是多数规则的推广。对于顶部均匀先验和任意域，定理4.1表明，每个顶部单调且对称的随机投票份额规则都是OBIC的。在满足某些自然“丰富性”条件的域上，我们证明，若一个对称且强顶部响应的随机投票份额规则相对于某个先验是OBIC的，则该先验必然为顶部均匀先验。我们还为否决份额规则提供了类似的结果，这些规则是反多数规则的概率推广。

title: AIC for many-regressor heteroskedastic regressions
title_zh: 多回归元异方差回归的AIC
title_primary: 多回归元异方差回归的AIC
title_secondary: AIC for many-regressor heteroskedastic regressions
authors: Stanislav Anatolyev
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The original and corrected Akaike information criteria (AIC) have been routinely used for model selection for ages. The penalty terms in these criteria are tied to the classical normal linear regression, characterized by conditional homoskedasticity and a small number of regressors relative to the sample size. We derive, from the same principles, a general version that takes account of conditional heteroskedasticity and regressor numerosity. The new AICm penalty takes a form of a ratio of certain weighted average error variances. The classical results on asymptotic prediction optimality of AIC are extended to AICm in heteroskedastic possibly misspecified models. Further, the infeasible AICm penalty can be operationalized via unbiased estimation of individual variances. Under suitable conditions, the feasible AICm criterion differs from the infeasible counterpart up to an asymptotically negligible term, and also possesses the property of asymptotic optimality. In simulations, the feasible AICm tends to select models that deliver systematically better out-of-sample predictions than the classical criteria. In the empirical application to an impact of legalized abortion on crime reduction, AICm tends to select a more parsimonious model than non-heteroskedasticity-robust versions of AIC.
abstract_zh: 原始和修正的赤池信息准则（AIC）长期以来一直被常规用于模型选择。这些准则中的惩罚项与经典正态线性回归相关联，其特征是条件同方差性以及相对于样本量而言较少的回归元数量。我们从相同的原理出发，推导出一个通用版本，该版本考虑了条件异方差性和回归元数量众多的情况。新的AICm惩罚项采取某种加权平均误差方差之比的形式。关于AIC渐近预测最优性的经典结果被扩展到异方差且可能设定错误的模型中的AICm。此外，不可行的AICm惩罚项可以通过对个体方差的无偏估计来实现操作化。在适当条件下，可行的AICm准则与不可行的对应准则之间的差异在渐近意义下可忽略不计，并且同样具有渐近最优性。在模拟中，可行的AICm倾向于选择比经典准则系统性地产生更好样本外预测的模型。在关于合法堕胎对减少犯罪影响的经验应用中，AICm倾向于选择比非异方差稳健版本的AIC更简约的模型。

title: Understanding Egg Price Volatility and Policy Implications in the U.S. With Machine Learning
title_zh: 美国鸡蛋价格波动及其政策含义的机器学习分析

authors: Xuemei Zhao, Simon Meister, Lucie Maruejols, Xiaohua Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-05-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Eggs are an inexpensive and sustainable source of proteins, but volatility in the U.S. egg prices has intensified in recent years, raising concerns over food affordability and market stability. This study examines the drivers of U.S. egg price dynamics over 2004–2025 using a two‐stage framework that combines LASSO‐based variable selection with an ARIMAX forecasting model. The results reveal strong price persistence, together with significant impacts of energy, feed costs and seasonal demand. The influence of avian influenza is strongly time‐dependent, with limited effects in full‐sample averages but significant impacts during high‐intensity outbreak periods, particularly in the mid‐2010s and after 2022. Out‐of‐sample forecasts indicate that the LASSO‐ARIMAX model reduces forecast errors by more than 60% relative to a univariate ARIMA benchmark. These findings suggest that stabilizing key input costs, strengthening timely epidemiological surveillance, and proactively managing predictable seasonal demand pressures are more effective than relying on any single explanatory factor.
abstract_zh: 鸡蛋是一种廉价且可持续的蛋白质来源，但近年来美国鸡蛋价格波动加剧，引发了对食品可负担性和市场稳定性的担忧。本研究采用两阶段框架，结合基于LASSO的变量选择与ARIMAX预测模型，考察了2004-2025年间美国鸡蛋价格动态的驱动因素。结果显示，价格具有强持续性，同时能源、饲料成本和季节性需求的影响显著。禽流感的影响具有强烈的时间依赖性：在全样本平均值中影响有限，但在高强度疫情暴发期（尤其是2010年代中期及2022年后）影响显著。样本外预测表明，相较于单变量ARIMA基准模型，LASSO-ARIMAX模型将预测误差降低了60%以上。这些发现表明，稳定关键投入成本、加强及时流行病学监测以及主动管理可预测的季节性需求压力，比依赖任何单一解释因素更为有效。

title: Emission Reporting for Agriculture: Frameworks and Metrics Matter
title_zh: 农业排放报告：框架与指标的重要性
title_primary: 农业排放报告：框架与指标的重要性
title_secondary: Emission Reporting for Agriculture: Frameworks and Metrics Matter
authors: Johnny Machon, Christophe d'Abbadie, Ross Kingwell
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Frameworks and metrics that reliably describe agricultural emission sources and carbon sinks are critical to the formulation of cost‐effective mitigation investment. This study identifies and compares three distinct emission reporting frameworks across metrics of total emissions and emissions intensity. The frameworks and metrics are applied to agricultural industries in Western Australia. Findings for 2005 and 2023 and the trends and uncertainties over the intervening period are reported. This study novelly considers a framework that includes emissions and sequestration from land use, land use change and forestry (LULUCF) activities at an industry scale. Most of Western Australia's agricultural emissions occur in the beef, sheep and grains industries, which also dominate agricultural land use. The emissions intensity of the grains industry in particular is highly sensitive to the inclusion of LULUCF activities. While large uncertainties surround emissions and sequestration from LULUCF activities, there are indications that the effect of LULUCF on emissions has changed considerably over time. We conclude it is preferable not to rely solely on one framework or one reporting metric. We highlight that more research is needed to lessen uncertainties surrounding LULUCF activities by agricultural industries.
abstract_zh: 摘要 可靠描述农业排放源与碳汇的框架和指标，对于制定成本有效的减缓投资至关重要。本研究识别并比较了三种不同的排放报告框架，涵盖总排放量和排放强度指标。这些框架和指标被应用于西澳大利亚州的农业产业。报告了2005年和2023年的研究结果，以及期间的趋势和不确定性。本研究创新性地考虑了一个框架，该框架在产业规模上纳入了土地利用、土地利用变化和林业（LULUCF）活动的排放与固碳。西澳大利亚州的大部分农业排放发生在牛肉、绵羊和谷物产业，这些产业也主导了农业土地利用。特别是谷物产业的排放强度，对LULUCF活动的纳入高度敏感。尽管围绕LULUCF活动的排放与固碳存在较大不确定性，但有迹象表明，LULUCF对排放的影响随时间发生了显著变化。我们得出结论，不宜仅依赖单一框架或单一报告指标。我们强调，需要更多研究以减少农业产业LULUCF活动相关的不确定性。

title: Flying below the radar: Insider trading by executives below the top
title_zh: 隐匿于雷达之下：非高层管理人员的内部交易
title_primary: 隐匿于雷达之下：非高层管理人员的内部交易
title_secondary: Flying below the radar: Insider trading by executives below the top
authors: Hans K. Hvide, Kasper Meisner Nielsen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To enforce insider trading laws, financial regulators require top executives to make their own-company trades public. One implication of this regulatory focus is that executives below the top fly under the radar. We use administrative register data from Norway to examine whether executives below the top in listed companies earn abnormal returns on purchases in own-company stock. We find evidence of abnormal returns on such trades, about 50 to 100 basis points at the 1-month horizon. The abnormal returns on purchases in other stocks are negative, making high investor ability an unlikely explanation.
abstract_zh: 为执行内幕交易法规，金融监管机构要求高层管理人员公开其对本公司股票的交易。这一监管重点的一个隐含结果是，高层以下的管理人员得以规避监管。我们利用挪威的行政登记数据，考察上市公司中非高层管理人员在购买本公司股票时是否获得异常回报。研究发现，此类交易存在异常回报的证据，在1个月的时间跨度内约为50至100个基点。而购买其他股票的异常回报为负，这使得高投资者能力成为不太可能的解释。

title: Maximizing experimental power through dynamic treatment assignment
title_zh: 通过动态处理分配最大化实验效力
title_primary: 通过动态处理分配最大化实验效力
title_secondary: Maximizing experimental power through dynamic treatment assignment
authors: Glory Orivri, Stephen Morgan, Bachir Kassas
official: 官方在线 2026-03-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Experimental methods have gained significant traction in agricultural economics in recent decades through the growing use of laboratory experiments, lab‐in‐the‐field studies, and experimental designs embedded in online surveys. However, replicability remains a persistent challenge and a critical benchmark for rigor in experimental economics research. Previous studies showed a strong correlation between statistical power and replicability, highlighting the importance of combining sample size with optimal study design to maximize power in experimental economics research. Despite power analysis being well established in randomized controlled trials, experimental economists have had to rely on rules of thumb (e.g., allocate equal number of subjects to each group), which may not guarantee optimal power. In this study, we propose an adaptive treatment assignment procedure to improve statistical power in experimental studies, using an experimental design that updates the researcher's beliefs about the standard deviation ratio of outcomes under different treatments. We simulate experimental data collection under different updating rules to test the expected gains in power compared to the naïve (conventional) method of equal treatment assignment. Our results show significant gains in power under our proposed adaptive procedures compared to equal treatment assignment. These gains in power are directly proportional to the standard deviation ratio between treatments. Importantly, the power achieved under our proposed adaptive treatment assignment procedures was consistently almost identical to the maximum theoretical power achievable given the study parameters. We thus provide a practical and easy‐to‐use tool that can help researchers optimize treatment assignment in their experimental studies to maximize power.
abstract_zh: 摘要 近几十年来，通过实验室实验、实地实验室研究和嵌入在线调查的实验设计的日益普及，实验方法在农业经济学中获得了显著关注。然而，可复制性仍然是实验经济学研究中一个持续的挑战，也是衡量严谨性的关键基准。以往研究表明，统计功效与可复制性之间存在强相关性，凸显了在实验经济学研究中将样本量与最优研究设计相结合以最大化功效的重要性。尽管功效分析在随机对照试验中已得到充分确立，但实验经济学家不得不依赖经验法则（例如，将相同数量的受试者分配到各组），这可能无法保证最优功效。在本研究中，我们提出了一种自适应处理分配程序，以提高实验研究中的统计功效，该实验设计会更新研究者对不同处理下结果标准差比率的信念。我们模拟了不同更新规则下的实验数据收集过程，以检验与朴素（传统）等量处理分配方法相比，功效的预期提升。我们的结果显示，与等量处理分配相比，我们提出的自适应程序在功效方面有显著提升。这些功效提升与处理间的标准差比率成正比。重要的是，在我们提出的自适应处理分配程序下实现的功效，始终与给定研究参数下可达到的最大理论功效几乎一致。因此，我们提供了一个实用且易于使用的工具，可帮助研究人员优化其实验研究中的处理分配，以最大化功效。

title: Empirical analysis of monetization and sovereign default: a logit and random forest analysis
title_zh: 货币化与主权违约的实证分析：基于Logit与随机森林方法
title_primary: 货币化与主权违约的实证分析：基于Logit与随机森林方法
title_secondary: Empirical analysis of monetization and sovereign default: a logit and random forest analysis
authors: Masaki Fukui Shogo Yoshida Keigo Kameda a School of Policy Studies, Kwansei Gakuin University, Sanda, Japanb Nomura Asset Management Co. Ltd., Koto, Japan
official: 官方在线 2025-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: There is a prevailing claim, particularly among proponents of modern monetary theory (MMT), which sovereign defaults on public debt denominated in a sovereign currency can be avoided through monetization. Despite considerable opposition to this assertion, to the best of the authors‘ knowledge, no rigorous empirical analysis has been conducted to test this proposition. This study aims to fill this gap by statistically analysing the validity of the proposition using traditional logistic regression and a machine-learning technique known as random forest. The findings suggest that, although the share of public debt denominated in a sovereign currency indeed reduces the probability of sovereign default, other factors, such as the public debt-to-gross domestic product ratio and the economic growth rate, do significantly influence the probability of sovereign default. These results indicate that the data do not support the MMT’s assertion.
abstract_zh: 有一种普遍观点，尤其在现代货币理论（MMT）的支持者中流传，认为以主权货币计价的公共债务可以通过货币化来避免主权违约。尽管这一论断面临相当大的反对意见，但据作者所知，尚无严谨的实证分析对此命题进行检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过使用传统逻辑回归和一种称为随机森林的机器学习技术，对命题的有效性进行统计分析。研究结果表明，尽管以主权货币计价的公共债务比例确实降低了主权违约的概率，但其他因素，如公共债务与国内生产总值之比以及经济增长率，确实显著影响主权违约的概率。这些结果说明，数据并不支持MMT的论断。
